title: The Seat Swap at the Cinema
scene: Two friends discover their cinema seats are separated. One suggests asking a stranger to swap, but the other prefers not to pressure anyone.
sceneJa: 映画館で友人と席が離れていると判明。席の交換を頼む案が出るが、相手に無理をさせないよう相談する。

chunks.ja: チケットを確認すると

chunks.en: our seats were in different rows.
chunks.ja: 席が別々の列だったことに。

chunks.en: We could ask someone to switch,
chunks.ja: 誰かに席を替わってもらえないか聞くこともできるけど

chunks.en: but I don't want to put them on the spot.
chunks.ja: 相手を困らせたくないな。

chunks.en: How about we check with the staff first?
chunks.ja: まずスタッフに確認してみない？

chunks.en: If there are two seats together,
chunks.ja: 隣り合う席が2つあれば

chunks.en: otherwise, we can stick with what we've got.
chunks.ja: なければ今の席のままでいいよ。

chunks.en: The staff found us two seats at the back,
chunks.ja: スタッフが後方に2席見つけてくれて

chunks.en: so we didn't have to bother anyone.
chunks.ja: 誰にも迷惑をかけずに済んだ。

chunks.en: I was more worried about blocking the aisle
chunks.ja: 通路をふさいでしまうほうが心配だった
離れて座ることよりも。

questions.question: 「相手をその場で困らせる」に当たる表現は？
questions.explanation: put someone on the spot は突然の要求や質問で答えにくい立場に置くこと。

questions.question: stick with what we've got の意味は？
options: 今ある選択肢のままにする
questions.explanation: stick with は選択を変えずに続けること。

questions.question: Why does the speaker suggest checking with the staff first?
questions.explanation: 相手に無理なお願いをせずに解決できる方法を探している。

speak: In 30 seconds, tell a friend you have seats apart at a concert or cinema. Suggest checking with staff first, explain why you don't want to put anyone on the spot, and say what you'll do if no seats are available.
review: New: put someone on the spot（相手を困らせる）, Fair point（確かにそうだね）, stick with what we've got（今のままにする）. Review: How about we ...?（〜しない？）, To be fair（正直なところ）. Read aloud: soften 'Fair point'; pause before 'otherwise'.
